serpents_blood: Heals a random amount between 1 and 25 HP.
shield_potion: Grants shield equal to your missing HP (max 50).
reforge_potion: Rerolls every spell stored in your backpack.
awakening_potion: Wands refill mana 200% faster for {s} s.
refresh_potion: Restocks wares and rerolls reachable doors in every room.
lockpick_potion: Pops every lock in this room, even cursed chests, without the curse.
midas_potion: Every foe in the room except bosses turns into coins.
discount_potion: Marks down every price in this room.
levitation_potion: You float above the ground until you pass the next door.
invisibility_potion: You vanish from sight for {s} s; attacking does not reveal you.
invincibility_potion: Nothing can harm you for {s} s.
petrification_potion: Turn to stone: immune to all damage for {s} s, but you cannot cast. Moving breaks it.
agility_potion: Move speed +0.6 for the rest of the run.
scale_potion: Your body size changes for the rest of the run.
crystal_potion: Wand mana regen +1 for the rest of the run.
unstable_red_potion: Max HP shifts by either -5 or +15 for the rest of the run.
unstable_blue_potion: Max MP shifts by either -5 or +15 for the rest of the run.
purification_potion: Lifts every curse, but you lose all coins, keys and shield.
wealth_potion: Adds coins equal to 25% of what you carry.
tears_of_the_goddess: Lifts every curse, but only if you bear 5 different curse marks.
relic_potion: Levels up a random relic, or grants a common relic if none can grow.
reset_potion: Returns a relic of your choice to its starting level.
sacrificial_potion: Trade 20% of your current HP for that many coins.
locksmith_potion: Doubles your keys, or gives 1 key if you have none.
pure_castor_oil: Shrugs off poison and slime in this room; for 10 s you drift toward the cursor, poisoning and slowing foes in your wake.
duplication_potion: Doubles the healing, shields, coins and keys found in this room.
emergency_potion: Grants temporary shield equal to your missing HP until the next room.
conversion_potion: Trade 40% of your current HP for that much shield.
